cause: Training/serving skew from a missing transform on f2. The training pipeline applies a log1p transform to f2 (training_f2 = log1p(raw)), but the online serving path serves the raw untransformed value. Across all matched entities the relationship is exact: serving_f2 = expm1(training_f2), equivalently training_f2 = log1p(serving_f2) (max residual ~6e-7). Features f1, f3, f4, f5 are identical between paths (correlation 1.0, zero difference). The fix is to apply the same log1p transform in the serving feature computation (or register it as an on-demand/model-dependent transformation so both paths share it).
